Title:LIQUORS DUTIES
MPs Speaking:Mr T. M. Hart;

LIQUORS DUTIES


    Mr T. M. Hart: Sir, I have His Excellency the Governor's authority to move, 

  Intoxicating Liquors.                  Duty.

                                         $  c.

  (a) Samsu (including Medicated Samsu)  27 00 per proof gallon.

  (b) Ale, Beer, Stout, Porter, Cider    

      and Perry                           4 80 per gallon.



II. The duty payable upon intoxicating liquors

distilled, fermented, made or prepared in any place

licensed under the Liquors Revenue Ordinance for

the distillation, fermentation, making or

preparation of intoxicating liquors shall be: -



Governments  in the Dominions under Trusteeship or the British Pro-

tectorates and Protected States, the Trust

Territories shall be levied thereon.

No duty shall be levied.


    The increases in duty have been in force since that date.
